name: Fridge
description: A see-through Panel variant in 2x2, 2x3 or 3x3 footprints that opens when X customers are filled, letting you see the boxes underneath while it is still closed.
howToPlay: Two fridges are chilling on the board. You can see straight through the glass to the boxes inside, but you cannot tap them yet. Every customer you fill — any colour — ticks each fridge counter down by 1. The small 2x2 fridge opens after 3 customers, the big 3x3 after 12 — the counter is scaled to the footprint. Because you can already see what is waiting inside, plan your order: decide what to spend now and what to save for the moment the glass clears. Tap a box behind the glass and it will push back at you.
author: Ilayda
